content: Cron Trigger CPU limits: 10ms (Free) / 30s for sub-hourly, 15min for hourly+ (Paid). Failed/overrun scheduled runs are NOT retried, next attempt waits for the next tick. Workers Free plan external subrequest limit is 50/invocation (confirmed Feb 2026 changelog); Paid plan default 10,000/invocation (configurable up to 10M). Long/bulk jobs should be chunked across multiple invocations (cursor pagination) or offloaded to Queues, not looped in a single cron run.
